a_before_b.rationale: Evaluating domain-specific capabilities with functional correctness and efficiency metrics is not required to assess an evaluation pipeline for cost, latency, and metric correlation, as pipeline evaluation focuses on operational characteristics rather than domain-specific functional correctness.

b_before_a.rationale: Assessing an evaluation pipeline for cost, latency, and metric correlation is not required to evaluate domain-specific capabilities using functional correctness and efficiency metrics, as domain capability evaluation can be performed independently of pipeline operational analysis.
